endpoint: Finish the Artin evaluations on the eight already constructed reduced half ideals, using their exact prime factors instead of requiring one coprime cyclic residue representation.
method: Factor only the eight fixed reduced ideal norms (about120bits). For every prime-ideal factor P evaluate each globally unramified character as its Hilbert pairing with a local uniformizer. Evaluate the two large characters factorwise. Check norm and ideal reconstruction and sum with ideal valuations. Compare the combined Artin column rank with the generic six-column rank.
boundary: Verification repair for fixed half ideals, not a new selector or search. All character inputs are equation/generic-only. Artin and CT remain distinct; zero Artin columns do not prove principal half ideals.
